title: ProofStudio: Five Proof Assistants in the Browser
abstract: arXiv:2611.05540v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent advances in AI-assisted proof automation are extending the use of proof assistants in software verification and mathematics. However, greater proof automation does not remove users' responsibility to assess whether formal statements capture their intended requirements, making education in formal specification and reasoning essential. To lower the installation and learning barriers associated with mature proof assistants, we present ProofStudio, a browser-based environment integrating Isabelle/HOL, Lean, Rocq, HOL4, and HOL Light with corresponding worked examples, preconfigured proof search, and contextual AI assistance. With ProofStudio, users can explore formal specifications and proofs across five systems without local installation, inspecting native prover feedback and experimenting with automation through a common interface.

translated_title: ProofStudio：浏览器中的五种证明助手
translated_abstract: 人工智能辅助证明自动化的最新进展正在拓展证明助手在软件验证和数学领域的应用。然而，更高的证明自动化程度并不能免除用户评估形式化陈述是否准确表达其预期需求的责任，这使得形式化规约与推理的教育变得至关重要。为了降低使用成熟证明助手所带来的安装与学习门槛，我们提出了ProofStudio，这是一个基于浏览器的环境，集成了Isabelle/HOL、Lean、Rocq、HOL4和HOL Light五种证明助手，并配有相应的已解答示例、预配置的证明搜索以及情境化的AI辅助。借助ProofStudio，用户无需本地安装即可探索这五种系统中的形式化规约与证明，通过统一界面查看原生存证反馈并试验各种自动化功能。
tldr: ProofStudio是一个基于浏览器的集成环境，将Isabelle/HOL、Lean、Rocq、HOL4和HOL Light五种证明助手统一到同一界面中，无需本地安装即可降低形式化规约与证明的学习门槛并支持自动化实验。
en_tdlr: ProofStudio is a browser-based environment integrating five proof assistants (Isabelle/HOL, Lean, Rocq, HOL4, and HOL Light), enabling users to explore formal specifications, proofs, and automation through a common interface without local installation.
